description:
One corpus-time-indexed document. `content_hash` is what makes corpus-time
caching possible (docs/efficiency-and-processing-architecture.md §3): a document
whose hash and `parser_version` are unchanged from a prior index run is not
reparsed or re-segmented.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the raw document bytes/text.
content_hash.title: Content Hash

source_version.description: Author/publisher-declared version or revision identifier, if any -- distinct from content_hash, which is derived, not declared.
source_version.title: Source Version

title: SourceDocument
